baseline.comparison: The four final images load the exact same serialized public fixture JSON as the clean2736808 captures, including its legacy capacity schema. Functional area-v1 upgrade/new-face checks use separate small fixtures. Paint, shares, seed, cameras and render quality stay fixed for the paired visual comparison.

visualSettings.shaderAndMaterial: Normal current runtime, no hidden mesh, shader-uniform override, texture replacement or diagnostic lighting.

200m.type: Nominal200m assembly with one192x112x96m box and an internal generator

1600m.type: 1600mwedge hull with four physically grounded terraces; not a stock ISD

readinessMethod.definition: Each readyMs is one observed public load or a real Apply/Undo/Split click until real worker stats+geometry adoption and editor idle. Snapshot analysis follows timing.
readinessMethod.limit: These are single observations from this verification session, not matched before/after performance measurements. No speedup, FPS or hardware GPU claim is made.

scopeLimitations: The screenshots use representative generated structures, not the user's unavailable actual1600m save or a stock ISD model.
Browser checks cover the listed UI, save, capacity and split cases; no operational combat/flight, physical phone or gamepad test was run.
Cosmetic structural depth changes rendered recess/floors but does not grant extra functional volume or performance. Functional capacity uses its separate area/depth/allocation model.
Old capacity remains intact on appearance-only edits. Explicit upgrade changes physical capacity and can change mass/cost/power/crew; Undo restores the old ledger.

Fresh area capacity uses role/area records. Migrated faces can retain legacy inactive inventory or alias records, so three fresh role records do not mean every old design always stores exactly three rows.
